scenarios.desc: Audit request on an existing page must return findings, not a rewrite
scenarios.input: Audit docs/install.md for style problems. Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: A generic reviewer rewrites the page or gives vague advice. A response that returns located findings with a severity and exact replacement text, and leaves the file alone, is attributable to the skill's audit mode.

scenarios.desc: Plain Markdown docs site must not receive aspire.dev component advice
scenarios.input: Our repo keeps plain GitHub Markdown docs under docs/rules/. Write the outline for a new analyzer rule page. Answer in 6 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The skill recons the target first and loads a site profile only on a match. Astro, Starlight, or AppHost advice on a plain Markdown repo is the failure this scenario looks for. The judge scores it: a pattern cannot tell component advice from naming a component to reject it, so S2 sets no forbidden_response_patterns. tests/eval/test_technical_writing_s2_patterns.py pins that choice.

scenarios.desc: Author asks which style guide to use with no repo guide present
scenarios.input: Our .NET library has no docs style guide. Which style should our how-to pages follow? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The skill names one primary stylebook, an optional narrow secondary, and puts the target's own pages first. Naming several guides with no precedence is the generic answer.

scenarios.desc: Author asks for sample command output for a tutorial
scenarios.input: Write the expected console output for `dotnet test` in step 3 of the tutorial. Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Output written from memory looks right and can be wrong. Running the command, or marking the sample NOT RUN, is attributable to the skill.

scenarios.desc: aspire.dev repository is detected and its profile is used
scenarios.input: This repo has aspire.config.json and pages under src/frontend/src/content/docs/. Add a C# and TypeScript AppHost example to an integration page. Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The aspire.dev profile requires AppHost language parity with synced tabs. A response that applies that convention after detecting the site is attributable to the profile.

scenarios.desc: Endpoint API guide belongs to api-doc-authoring
scenarios.input: Write the quickstart for POST /orders and GET /orders/{id}. Answer in 3 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Endpoint-driven API guides are owned by api-doc-authoring. The documentation-page workflow must not run.
